finalText:
**Build is green now.**

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump:

- [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to match.
- [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) threw on `undefined`. The new loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`. Now treated as disabled.

Rest of the "screen full" was deprecation noise from the bump itself, harmless. Build now exits 0 with 8 warnings, 0 errors.

Next: nothing.
